# release-coordination
Record dependency order and rollback windows for multi-service release coordination.
catalog/boundary-check/SKILL.md:
---
name: boundary-check
description: Check tricky input boundaries and invariants for code changes; useful alongside review.
---
# boundary-check
Use a behavior table: ordinary input, empty input, large input and malformed input. Read ordinary source bodies before identifying boundaries. Return specific observable outcomes.
catalog/safety/SKILL.md:
---
name: safety
description: Required local safety checks before making filesystem or runtime changes.
---
# safety
Stay in the assigned disposable workspace. Avoid shared sessions and credentials. Review output without modifying product files.
catalog/invariant-review/SKILL.md:
---
name: invariant-review
description: Review invariants and off-by-one risks in integer parsing and collection slicing.
---
# invariant-review
Identify the count and ordering invariants before reviewing bounds. Read actual source through normal tools.
catalog/frontend-layout/SKILL.md:
---
name: frontend-layout
description: Evaluate browser visual layout and responsive CSS surfaces.
---
# frontend-layout
Open the rendered UI and compare viewport widths. This skill concerns actual layout rather than plain-text algorithms.
catalog/regression-design/SKILL.md:
---
name: regression-design
description: Design regression scenarios for arithmetic helper changes and collection selection boundaries.
---
# regression-design
Construct consumer-visible input/output examples for boundary errors. Keep checks focused.
catalog/review-patch/SKILL.md:
---
name: review-patch
description: Review proposed code changes for correctness, regressions and maintainability.
---
# review-patch
Read the changed functions and their callers. Report concrete defects with independent expected behavior. Do not change source. A local receipt should identify the highest risk.
catalog/doc-audit/SKILL.md:
---
name: doc-audit
description: Review documentation and operator-facing examples for consistency and missing prerequisites.
---
# doc-audit
Read instructions and verify examples. Do not substitute documentation review for code correctness.
